driverFormulas.rev: Revenue = Contract Revenue − KPI Service Credits & Rebates
driverFormulas.cogs: Cost to Serve = Third-Party Costs + Delivery Workforce + Delivery Platforms & Sites
driverFormulas.gp: Contract Margin = Revenue − Cost to Serve
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Contract Margin % = Contract Margin / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Overheads = Bid & Account Management + Technology & AI + Group Functions
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: Adjusted EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation & Amortisation = Right-of-Use Assets + Equipment + Software
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: Adjusted Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Net Finance Costs & Other = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Adjusted Profit Before Tax = Operating Profit + Net Finance & Other
driverFormulas.ni: Adjusted Profit After Tax = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Margin % = Profit After Tax / Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Contract Assets + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Contract Assets & Work in Progress = Accrued Income + Unbilled WIP + Contract Fulfilment Assets
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill & Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Deferred Income
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Non-Current Liabilities = Borrowings + Leases + Pension Deficit & Provisions
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit After Tax + D&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Equity
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
